description: Spectral clustering on 20000 synthetic single cells — heavy CPU bubble via 20k×20k affinity matrix + eigendecomposition, targets 55-70% GPU idle
prompt:
Write and execute Python code (in a single execute block, no explanation before the code) to do the following:

import numpy as np, time
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.manifold import SpectralEmbedding
from sklearn.metrics import adjusted_rand_score, silhouette_score

np.random.seed(42)
X = np.vstack([np.random.multivariate_normal(k*np.ones(20)*0.5, np.eye(20), 2500) for k in range(8)])
true_labels = np.repeat(np.arange(8), 2500)
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

t0 = time.time()
sc = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=8, affinity='rbf', gamma=0.5, n_init=20, random_state=42, assign_labels='kmeans', n_jobs=1).fit(X_scaled)
sc_time = time.time() - t0

t0 = time.time()
SpectralEmbedding(n_components=16, affinity='rbf', gamma=0.5, random_state=42, n_jobs=1).fit_transform(X_scaled)
se_time = time.time() - t0

ari = adjusted_rand_score(true_labels, sc.labels_)
sil = silhouette_score(X_scaled, sc.labels_, sample_size=2000, random_state=42)
unique, counts = np.unique(sc.labels_, return_counts=True)
for cid, cnt in zip(unique, counts): print(f'cluster {cid}: {cnt} cells')
print(f'ARI={ari:.4f} sil={sil:.4f} sc_time={sc_time:.1f}s se_time={se_time:.1f}s')
notes: HEAVY bubble task v3. 20k cells × 8 clusters (2500/cluster). Key changes from 8k version: (1) 20k×20k affinity matrix = 1.6GB, 400M RBF evals — 4× more work than 8k; (2) cluster separation k*0.5 instead of k*1.5 — adjacent clusters overlap, affinity matrix is NOT block-diagonal, ARPACK needs many more Lanczos iterations; (3) gamma=0.5 (larger neighborhood); (4) n_init=20 k-means repeats; (5) SpectralEmbedding with n_components=16. Both 8k attempts ran in 3s and 13s because clusters were too well-separated → block-diagonal affinity → trivial ARPACK. Overlapping clusters force dense non-block-diagonal eigendecomp. Expected execute: 3-15 min. Results go to results/spectral_clustering_20k/.
